chunks.text: Pune Workshop Hall accommodates up to 40 attendees. The room supports classroom seating and projector use.
Pune Workshop Hall offers vegetarian and standard catering packages when requested at least three days in advance.
Pune Workshop Hall bookings may be cancelled without a fee up to seven days before the event.
Pune Conference Centre accommodates up to 80 attendees and has two presentation rooms.
External catering is permitted at Pune Conference Centre with prior venue approval.
